root_idea.summary: The root centers on a perceptible trace or effect of beauty, adornment, and well-being.
root_idea.development: From the effect of beauty and splendor come meanings connected with beautifying writing, speech, and objects; visible marks or complexion; ink as a means of beautifying writing; scholars as those whose learning leaves lasting traces; and joy manifested in a person's appearance. Other lexical branches extend to patterned cloth, scars, and abundant clouds.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form حَبَرَ.
Displayed under the singular dictionary citation form حِبْرٌ, whose Quranic plural is أَحْبَارٌ.

senses.definition: To be made happy and honored, enjoying ease and plenty.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic usage is in the imperfect passive: the recipients are brought into joy, well-being, and honor, with the effect of their happiness apparent in them.

senses.definition: To be delighted by the pleasures of Paradise, including sweet melody or musical entertainment.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an explicitly reported Quranic interpretation of the passive construction, presenting the delight as an experience of Paradise rather than merely an inward emotional state.

senses.definition: A religious scholar or learned authority; in the Quran, a scholar or rabbi among the People of the Scripture.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural أَحْبَارُ and its inflected forms. The usage concerns religious authorities whose learning and example carry influence among their communities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make beautiful, adorn, embellish, or make clear; applied to writing, poetry, speech, language, pronunciation, or recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be verbal, written, or artistic; the sense includes improving its form and making it pleasing or intelligible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something happy, joyful, at ease, or honored.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the active use corresponding to the passive Quranic form; the subject may be God, a person, or an event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the skin to be beaten so that a mark of the beating remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized resultative construction concerning a visible mark on the skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a wound to break out afresh, or to heal while leaving scars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The alternatives describe the course or residual effect of the wound rather than a general meaning of happiness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the teeth to become yellow, especially with yellowness mingled with their whiteness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also connected with the lexical description of yellowing or discoloration of the teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pare or finish an arrow well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a technical use concerning the careful preparation of an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a mark on a person or thing; of a blow, to mark the skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may take a person, an object, or the skin as the bearer of the mark.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A learned religious man, including a religious authority among Jewish, Christian, or Sabean communities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical usage is not restricted to the Quranic occurrence among Jewish religious scholars.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in beautifying or refining language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized personal designation derived from the root's association with adornment and excellence of expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or righteous man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical personal usage distinct from the occupational sense of religious scholar.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ink used for writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is explained as connected with beautifying and clarifying writing and with the marks made by ink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Variegation or figured patterning of cloth; a patterned fabric.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a textile sense, distinct from ink and from the personal designation for a scholar.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A visible mark of ease and plenty; hence beauty, good appearance, or complexion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote the outward effect of well-being or the pleasing aspect that satisfies the eye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark or trace left by beating, a healed wound, work, or labor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mark may be physical or the visible evidence of exertion; it need not be a mark of beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A like, equal, or fellow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separate nominal comparison sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A striped or variegated garment of Yemeni fabric, traditionally of cotton or linen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also be used in a construction describing a garment as being of this patterned fabric.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of ink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an occupational derivative from حِبْرٌ in the sense of ink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of garments called حِبَرٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This occupational term is connected with the textile sense, not with ink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young bustard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also associated with the male or young bird in related lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything at all; in the negative expression, nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a rare lexicalized expression reported as an exceptional branch of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Happiness, joy, gladness, ease, plenty, or ampleness of life's circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may emphasize cheerful delight or the broader condition of complete well-being and prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A variegated or striped garment or cloth; by extension, a new, soft, or fine piece of cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also occur in figurative expressions using a garment as an image of cheerfulness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clouds, especially clouds described as spotted or abundant in water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description of spotted clouds is attributed in the lexical evidence to one account and rejected by another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bustard, a well-known long-necked bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is used for both male and female and can function as a singular or collective designation; it also has reported plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very happy, joyful, or cheerful man; also a soft, tender, or delicate man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are personal descriptions derived from حُبُورٌ and are distinct from the bird designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird, especially the male or young of the bustard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This zoological usage is distinct from the personal adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sitting place or a company sitting together, especially a gathering of unrighteous persons or revellers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained as a place or group associated with enjoyment or festivity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or vessel in which ink is kept, such as an inkpot, earthen container, or glass bottle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word has several reported vocalic and morphological variants; the displayed form is a principal citation form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or circumstance in which happiness, joy, or gladness is usually found; a source of happiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The definition is general and is not restricted to the illustrative example of women.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose skin is marked by flea bites.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized description of visible marks on the skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow that has been well pared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the passive or resultative counterpart of the technical arrow-preparation sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that has been beautified, adorned, or decorated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may apply to an embellished object, poem, or other product of careful adornment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land that grows vegetation quickly and abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical agricultural description derived from the root's association with visible flourishing.

cautions: The singular associated with the Quranic plural أَحْبَارٌ is reported with vocalic variants حِبْرٌ and حَبْرٌ; this artifact uses حِبْرٌ as the principal citation form.
Historical Lane Quran citation notation is not used to manufacture modern verse locations; the Quran examples here use only independently supplied QAC locations.
